csv_scope_of_work: This announcement is for the selection of an Engineering Services (ES) Firm to perform design services, technical specifications, working drawings, cost estimates, as-built drawings, construction period services and site-visits for the Altoona VA Project 503- 26-109, Remediate Reserve Center UST at the Department of Veterans Affairs, Altoona VA Medical Center located in Altoona, Pennsylvania.

title: AE for C1DA Remediate Reserve Center
short_description: Design services for underground storage tank remediation at Altoona VA Medical Center.
project_scope: Remediation project for the Reserve Center underground storage tank (UST) at the Department of Veterans Affairs Altoona VA Medical Center. The scope includes design services, technical specifications, working drawings, cost estimates, as-built drawings, construction period services, and site visits. No detailed technical dimensions or building areas are stated.
services: Engineering and architecture services including architecture, civil engineering, cost estimating, construction period services, site visits, technical specifications, working drawings, and as-built drawings.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a remediation/UST environmental project, not a bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building structure.
- Scope focuses on underground tank remediation and associated AE services.
- Does not indicate architecturally demanding or structurally innovative work.
- Falls outside sbp's core target areas and is closer to environmental/civil remediation than structural design.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost $8.6M.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated in the source.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested: architecture services, civil engineering, construction/project management, and cost estimating. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
